snippet.title: [FreeStyle Football 2] PRE-ORDER NOW!
snippet.description:
Hello, Agents.

Our sincere thanks to everyone who has been waiting for the launch of FreeStyle Football 2. We're excited to share the details about pre-orders.

■ Pre-Order Period
October 14 (Wed), 2026, 01:00 – December 3 (Thu), 2026, 09:59 (UTC)

■ Pre-Order Editions
-Standard Edition
-Deluxe Edition (includes 72-hour Early Access)
-Ultimate Edition (includes 72-hour Early Access)
※ For more details, please check our website and video.

■ Launch Schedule by Edition
-Deluxe / Ultimate Edition (Early Access)
: November 30 (Mon), 2026, 10:00 (UTC)
-Standard Edition (Official Launch)
: December 3 (Thu), 2026, 10:00 (UTC)

■ Where to Pre-Order
-Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4004820/FreeStyle_Football_2/?utm_source=officialyoutubeww
-PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10016558
-Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/freestyle-football-2/9NL8MF491NRZ/0010
※ Prices may vary depending on your region and exchange rates.
※ Refunds and cancellations are subject to each platform's policies.
※ Pre-order benefits will be granted in-game after the official launch and can only be used on the platform where the purchase was made.

📢 FreeStyle Football 2 Pre-order Appreciation YouTube Cheer Event

We sincerely thank all users worldwide who have been eagerly awaiting the release of FreeStyle Football 2.
To reward your passionate support, we are holding a cheer event on our official YouTube channel!

■ YouTube Cheer Event Details
-Event Period: October 14, 2026, 01:00 – December 3, 2026, 00:59 (UTC)
-Winner Announcement: Winners will be notified individually via Discord DM.
-Reward Distribution: January 2027
-Reward: $20 Platform Gift Card
-Number of Winners: 5

■ Eligibility
-FreeStyle Football 2 Pre-order Purchasers (Standard Edition or higher)

■ How to Participate
-Subscribe to our official YouTube channel.
-Leave a comment with a cheering message for FreeStyle Football 2 and the character you are most looking forward to.
-Take a screenshot showing both the event video and your comment together.
-Submit it via the Google Form along with proof of your FreeStyle Football 2 pre-order purchase.
👉 [Youtube Link] https://youtu.be/WJ8Gjprqnc4?si=bLRrSOZtDyOpLmbe
👉 [Google Form Link] https://forms.gle/fiScjtULBKDbL1jg7

■ Submission Requirements
-Platform ID (Steam Profile Name / Xbox Gamertag / PSN ID)
-Screenshot of Purchase Proof
-Screenshot of your comment
-YouTube Channel Name
-Discord ID and contactable email address
※ Please ensure your pre-order purchase history and account name are visible in the screenshot, but hide your real name, address, order number, and payment details.

■ Event Notice
※ Winning multiple events across YouTube, X, and Instagram is not allowed. If selected in multiple events, only one win will be recognized.
※ If you unsubscribe, delete your comment, or cancel/refund your purchase before the rewards are distributed, your winning status will be voided.
※ The event period or rewards may be subject to change due to internal circumstances. In such cases, we will inform you through an announcement.
※ Winners may be asked for additional verification to confirm their identity.
※ Only one entry per person is allowed. In case of duplicate entries, only the first submitted entry will be recognized.

■ Official Discord
https://discord.com/invite/freestylefootball2

See you on the pitch on launch day!
Thank you for your continued support.
